name: Sign Rank / Radon Number (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, sign rank is $n$, while Radon number is $\lfloor\log_2(2n+2)\rfloor$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the $n$-singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, Radon number is $n$, while sign rank is at most $3$.
proof: The two canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Sign Rank and Radon Number of Full Cube and Singletons.
